name: OmaShaders
author: AktOn1
description: A bar icon with a picker list of full-screen GLSL effects (CRT, vignette, warm tint, mono, sepia, VHS, glitch and more) over every monitor. Runs inside Hyprland on the GPU: no extra window, no CPU use.

barWidget.description: Click to pick a full-screen effect from a list, right-click to turn off, scroll to step
